instruction: Import markdown notes in the "~/documents/personal/notes/" directory of my file system to my Simple Note account. Each markdown file should become a separate note in the Simple Note account. The title of each note should be taken from the name of the source file (excluding the directory path and file extension), replacing underscores in it with blank spaces.
notes: The directory listing and file contents are only known at runtime; the model assumes three markdown files in ~/documents/personal/notes/ (md-file-1..3), each with a static title (derived from the file name) and content. show_directory makes the directory listed, which gates show_file on each file in it; show_file makes the content readable; create_note (restricted to markdown files, each at most once) creates a note with the file's title and content and marks the file imported. The goal requires every markdown file to be imported and nothing else changed (no updates/deletes are modeled). supervisor.complete_task takes no API arguments (no answer requested); its three file parameters are task records used only to express the all-files-imported precondition without quantifiers. If the real directory contains a different number of .md files, add/remove file/title/content objects and adjust the complete-task arity accordingly.
